verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships an official first-party CLI, Inso CLI, with its own documentation. The docs show it automating API tests, linting OpenAPI specs (`inso lint spec`), and running non-interactively in CI with exit codes, which suits scripted and agent-driven use. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of AI- or agent-specific CLI ergonomics such as machine-readable output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.
Inso CLI is designed to run in a Continuous Integration (CI) environment. It disables prompts and provides exit codes to pass or fail the CI workflow.
In CI, use `inso lint spec <identifier>` to lint OpenAPI and fail builds on errors.
